topic: Adding data source quality flags to API
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on how to receive status indicators regarding the reliability of multiple data sources (e.g., telia, lam) provided by a third party via an API.

Two options were considered: 1) A separate endpoint containing date-specific flags for each source's operational status (ok/failed). 2) Adding these status fields directly into the existing `.parquet` files within the current API structure.

After discussion, it was decided that adding the quality attributes as new fields directly into the comprehensive `.parquet` file is the preferred method, as this avoids additional processing and simplifies data handling across periods.
decisions: The third party will add data source status flags (e.g., telia_data_status, lam_data_status) as new fields within the existing .parquet API files.
action_items: [p1] to write to the third party regarding the implementation of these changes.
